learning_objective: 🎯 Create beautiful art and solve visual puzzles using the awesome math of symmetry and mirror reflections!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you can fold a shape perfectly in half so that both sides match exactly, the shape is symmetrical. Think of a beautiful butterfly spreading its wings!
The special fold line down the middle is called the Line of Symmetry. Some shapes have one line, and some super shapes like a square have four!
If you only see half of a symmetrical drawing, you can use your imagination like a mirror to draw the exact reflection on the other side to complete it.

fun_activity.title: 🦋 The Paint Fold Trick
fun_activity.instructions: Fold a piece of paper in half. Open it, put a few drops of paint on one side of the fold, and press it closed again. Open it up to see a perfect symmetrical design!

quick_recap: ⭐ Symmetrical shapes have two identical halves that look like mirror images.
⭐ The imaginary line dividing the shape is the axis or line of symmetry.
⭐ Many things in nature, like leaves and human faces, show amazing symmetry!
